question: Assess the claim that Michael Jordan's scoring in 1990-91 was stronger than LeBron James's scoring in 2014-15. Compare regular-season and playoff scoring volume and shooting efficiency relative to the league. Compare teammates: core helpers first, then rotation scoring, minutes and recorded games. Check whether the per-game helper leaders adequately represent the supporting cast's recorded availability. Keep original samples and qualify any limited context.

nodes.label: Lead
nodes.description: Confirm the scoring claim, identities and scope; plan independent investigations.

nodes.label: Scoring evidence
nodes.description: Investigate the personal scoring volume, shooting efficiency, and postseason changes for Michael Jordan in the 1990-91 regular season and playoffs versus LeBron James in the 2014-15 regular season and playoffs using points, minutes, games, shooting attempts/percentages, and relative true shooting.

nodes.label: Era benchmarks
nodes.description: Investigate contemporaneous shooting benchmarks, league averages, and weighted relative true shooting context for the 1990-91 NBA season and the 2014-15 NBA season.

nodes.label: Supporting cast
nodes.description: Investigate bounded teammate scoring, minutes, and games for Michael Jordan's 1990-91 supporting cast and LeBron James's 2014-15 supporting cast across regular season and playoff phases.

nodes.label: Finals opponents
nodes.description: Investigate opponent regular-season records and Finals scoring contexts faced by Michael Jordan in 1990-91 and LeBron James in 2014-15.

nodes.label: Lead review
nodes.description: Inspect collected evidence and decide whether targeted follow-up is needed.
nodes.summary: Follow-up requested: The per-game core list includes Kevin Love with sparse recorded appearances relative to the returned rotation. A matched regular-season baseline is needed before treating this playoff sample as typical supporting-cast context.

nodes.label: Helper follow-up
nodes.description: Evidence-driven follow-up: The per-game core list includes Kevin Love with sparse recorded appearances relative to the returned rotation. A matched regular-season baseline is needed before treating this playoff sample as typical supporting-cast context. Check whether the original helper sample is adequate by retrieving the approved matched supporting-cast samples. Preserve original evidence and separate phases.
nodes.summary: Matched supporting-cast evidence collected; original samples retained.

nodes.label: Lead review
nodes.description: Inspect collected evidence and decide whether targeted follow-up is needed.
nodes.summary: Evidence review complete; proceed with the available coverage and disclosed gaps.

nodes.label: Writer
nodes.description: Select evidence and counterevidence; render and audit the sourced report.
nodes.summary: The report passed its numerical evidence checks.
